title: Translation is part of technical leadership
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Hear the original concern — Identify what matters to the originating team.; Connect the consequence — Explain why the receiving team needs to care.; Use a shared example — Preserve the distinction that changes the decision.; Agree a clear condition — Make the resulting action and owner clear..
